title: Trust Anchor V3.0
description: Entity whose credentials are accepted for issuing Instance Credentials.

AnchorID.description: ID for the trust anchor (URI, DNS name, or opaque string).

PublicKey.description: PK used by the trust anchor to sign Instance Credentials.

Algorithm.description: Signature algorithm ID from the Security Algorithm Taxonomy.

KeyValue.description: Public key material encoded as base64 or base64url.

Validity.description: Validity window for the trust anchor's signing authority.

Policies.description: Constraints on what the trust anchor is allowed to issue.

items.description: AIM instance classes or identifiers allowed by this trust anchor.
Process instance classes or IDs allowed by this trust anchor.
Algorithm identifiers from the Security Algorithm Taxonomy.

MaxCredentialLifetime.description: Optional maximum validity duration for issued credentials (ISO 8601 duration).

Revocation.description: Optional revocation information for the trust anchor.

CRL.description: URI of a certificate revocation list or equivalent.

OCSP.description: URI of an online status service.
